description: Ministry of Sports, Shipping and Aviation - Civil Aviation (Charges for the use of Aerodromes) Regulations 2022
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010, specifically establishing new charges for the use of aerodromes. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes - the focus is entirely on establishing new regulatory requirements for civil aviation operations.
